    const view = {

      phi: 1.18,

    };

    function updateCamera() {
      const sinPhi = Math.sin(view.phi);

      camera.position.set(
        cameraTarget.x + view.radius * sinPhi * Math.sin(view.theta),
        cameraTarget.y + view.radius * Math.cos(view.phi),
        cameraTarget.z + view.radius * sinPhi * Math.cos(view.theta)
      );

      camera.lookAt(cameraTarget);

    // Procedural wood texture; no external image assets are used.
    function createWoodTexture() {
      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = 1024;
      canvas.height = 256;

      const context = canvas.getContext("2d");
      const gradient = context.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
      gradient.addColorStop(0, "#d6a267");
      gradient.addColorStop(0.5, "#b97d43");
      gradient.addColorStop(1, "#d09a5c");

      context.fillStyle = gradient;
      context.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

      let seed = 81723;
      function random() {
        seed = (seed * 1664525 + 1013904223) >>> 0;
        return seed / 4294967296;
      }

      for (let i = 0; i < 230; i++) {
        const y = random() * canvas.height;
        const amplitude = 1 + random() * 7;
        const frequency = 0.006 + random() * 0.014;
        const phase = random() * Math.PI * 2;

        context.beginPath();
        context.moveTo(0, y);

        for (let x = 0; x <= canvas.width; x += 24) {
          const wave =
            Math.sin(x * frequency + phase) * amplitude +
            Math.sin(x * frequency * 0.43 + phase) * amplitude * 0.35;
          context.lineTo(x, y + wave);
